name: mychartmaster
description: Chart maker for Web, Windows, macOS and Linux (Tauri) — 31 chart types from CSV, TSV, Excel, ODS, JSON, XML, HTML and Markdown data; edit in a grid; style; export PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, SVG, PDF, HTML, Word, Markdown, CSV and Excel; print
author: SHKWON <knix008@naver.com>

scripts.build:win: npm run build:docs && node scripts/build.mjs win
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:docs && node scripts/build.mjs mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:docs && node scripts/build.mjs linux
scripts.build:all: npm run build:docs && node scripts/build.mjs all
